text.body: nagnaṃ mārabalaṃ yena nirjitaṃ bhavapaṃjaram | nirvāṇapadamāruḍhaṃ taṃ buddhaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 1 || ṣaṭkārakāṇi saṃbaṃdha uktānuktatayā dvidhā | vibhaktiśceti niśceyamavaśyaṃ yogamicchatā || 2 || yo yatra pratyayo jātaḥ samāso yatra vā bhavet | sa eva vakti yuñjānastasya liṃgena saṃkhyayā || 3 || liṃgasaṃkhyābhiyogaśca prāyo bhavati darśitaḥ | vedāḥ pramāṇamityādi prayogo yena sammataḥ || 4 || mukhyaṃ kartāramācaṣṭe pratyayo'nekakartṛko | mukhyaḥ prayojako jñeyaḥ prayukto nāparairyadi || 5 || duhādergauṇakaṃ karma nīvahādeḥ pradhānakam | inaṃte kartṛkarmaiva anyadvā vakti karmajaḥ || 6|| gamanāhārabodhārthaśabdārthāḥ karmadhātuṣu | aninaṃteṣu yaḥ kartā syādinaṃteṣu karma tat || 7 || na nīkhādya'diśabdāya kraṃdāhvā kartṛkarmakāḥ | tathā bhakṣirahiṃsāyāṃ vaho sārathikartṛkaḥ || 8 || hṛkrorapi tathā kartā inaṃte karma vā bhavet | abhivādidṛśorevamātmane viṣaye param || 9 || uktādanyadanuktaṃ syādukta syātprathamaiva hi | anukte tu bhavantyanyā dvitīyādyā yathāyatham || 10 || kartṛsaṃjñe tṛtīyā syāt‌ dvitīyā karmakārake | tayoratha bhavetṣaṣṭhī kṛtiniṣṭhādivarjite || 11 || ekadatte bhayaprāptau karmaṇyeva na kartari | akākāraprayoge tu ṣaṣṭhī syādubhayorapi || 12 || prāyasaḥ kathitā eva dṛśyaṃte kartṛkarmaṇoḥ | yathā'bhidhānamanyāsāṃ pravṛttirna nirākṛtā || 13 || tṛtīyā karaṇe prāyaścaturthī saṃpradānataḥ | paṃcamī syādapādāne tathā'dhāre tu saptamī || 14 || saṃbaṃdhe'tha bhavetṣaṣṭhī nirnayastāvadīdṛśaḥ | uktānuktavicāreṇa prayogastena gamyatām || 15 || nagnaṃ mārabalaṃ yena nirjitaṃ bhavapaṃjaram | nirvāṇapadamāruḍhaṃ taṃ buddhaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 1 || ihāyaṃ kartā bālavyutpattaye saṃkṣepataḥ saṃbaṃdhamabhidadhānaḥ prastuvannāha || ṣaṭkārakāṇi saṃbaṃdha uktānuktatayā dvidhā | vibhaktiśceti niśceyamavaśyaṃ yogamicchatā || 2 || ṣaṭkārakāṇi ityādi | asyāyamarthaḥ | yogaṃ saṃbaṃdhamicchatā cchātreṇāvaśyameveti niśceyamiti yāvat‌ katamat‌ tatrāha | ṣaṭkārakāṇīti saṃbaṃdha uktānuktatayā dvidhā vibhaktiśceti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ | ṣaṭkārakāṇi | kartṛkarmakaraṇasaṃpradānāpādānādhikaraṇanāmāni pratyekamuktānuktatayā dvidhā dviprakārāṇi vartaṃte | tathā saṃbaṃdho'pi | tadyathā | uktaḥ kartā | anuktaḥ kartā | uktaṃ karma | anuktaṃ karma | uktaṃ karaṇam‌ | anuktaṃ karaṇam‌ | uktaṃ saṃpradānam‌ | anuktaṃ saṃpradānam‌ | uktamapādānam‍ | anuktamapādānam‌ | uktamadhikaraṇam‌ | anuktamadhikaraṇam‌ | uktaḥ saṃbaṃdhaḥ | anuktaḥ saṃbaṃdhaḥ | iti tatra uktaḥ kartā yathā | jayati buddhadharmaḥ | jvalati hutāśanaḥ | edhate vidhuḥ | kārako devadattaḥ | vaiyākaraṇaḥ puruṣaḥ | kṛtaḥ praṇāmo yena sa kṛtapraṇāmaḥ puruṣaḥ | evamādiṣu ākhyātakṛttaddhitapratyayānāṃ samāsasya ca kartari vihitatvāduktaḥ kartetyucyate| ukte kartari prathameti nyāyātprathamā | anukte kartari jīyate buddhadharmeṇa | jvalyate hutāśanena | aidhyate vidhunā | kṛtaṃ devadattena | ( sakarmakasyāpi yadi karma na vivakṣyate tadā bhāve pratyaya ) evamādiṣu pratyayo na kartari vihita ityanuktatvātkartari tṛtīyā | uktaṃ karma yathā | kaṭaḥ kriyate | udanaḥ pacyate | grāmo gamyate | bhukta udanaḥ | śatikaḥ paṭaḥ | āruḍhavānaro vṛkṣaḥ | evamādiṣu pratyayānāṃ samāsasya ca karmavihitatvāt | uktaṃ prathamā karmetyucyate | ukte karmaṇi prathameti nyāyāt | anuktaṃ karma yathā | kaṭaṃ karoti | udanaṃ pacati | grāmaṃ gacchati | udanaṃ bhuktavān‌ | evamādiṣu pratyayo na karmaṇi vihita iti anuktatvātkarmaṇi dvitīyā | uktaṃ karaṇaṃ yathā | snānīyaṃ varṇam‌ | asyārthaḥ | snāyate yena varṇena tatsnānīyam‌ | kṛtyuṭo'nyatrāpīti vacanāt | karaṇe'nīyaḥ evamādikamuktaṃ karaṇamucyate uktatvātkaraṇe prathamā | anuktaṃ karaṇaṃ yathā | snāti varṇena | asinā chinatti | manasā meruṃ gamyate | athavā snāyate varṇena | asinā cchidyate | manasā gamyate ityādiṣu karaṇe pratyayo na vihita ityanuktatvātkaraṇe tṛtīyā | uktaṃ saṃpradānam | yathā dānīyo brāhmaṇaḥ | ayamarthaḥ | dīyate yasmai brāhmaṇāya sa dānīya iti kṛtyuṭo'nyatrāpi ceti vacanātsaṃpradāne anīyaḥ | evaṃ dakṣiṇīyaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ | dakṣiṇā yasmai dīyate sa dakṣiṇīyaḥ | īyastu hite iti yogavibhāgādiha saṃpradāne īyaḥ | evaṃ dattabhojano'tithiḥ | samāso'tra saṃpradane evamādikamuktatvātsaṃpradāne prathamā | anuktaṃ saṃpradānaṃ yathā | dadāti brāhmaṇāya | athavā dīyate brāhmaṇāya | evaṃ dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇāya | evamādiṣu pratyayo na saṃpradāne vihitaḥ iti anuktatvāt‌ saṃpradane caturthī | uktamapādānam | bhīmo rākṣasaḥ | bibhetyasmāditi bhīmaḥ bhīmādayo'pādāne iti bhībhīṣibhyāṃ mak‌ uṇādikaḥ | evaṃ uśannajanapado deśaḥ samāso'pādāne evamādiṣūktatvādapādāne prathamā | anuktamapādānaṃ yathā | bibheti rākṣasāt‌ | athavā bhīyate rākṣasāt‌ | evaṃ bhīto rākṣasāt‌ | nātrāpādāne pratyayo vihita ityanuktatvāt‌ apādāne paṃcamī | ūktādhikaraṇaṃ yathā | āsanaṃ pīṭham‌ ‘ ayamarthaḥ | āsyate yasminniti āsanam | karaṇādhikaraṇayośceti adhikaraṇe yuṭ‌ | evaṃ vaṭakinī pūrṇimāsī prāyeṇa vaṭakā bhujyaṃte yasyāṃ pūrṇimāsyāṃ taddhito ruḍhita itīn‌ | evaṃ mattamātaṃgaṃ vanaṃ samāso'dhikaraṇe evamādiṣūktatvādadhikaraṇe prathamā | anuktamadhikaraṇaṃ yathā | āste pīṭhe | athavā āsyate pīṭhe | evamāsitaṃ pīṭhe | gaṃgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ tileṣu tailam‌ | divi devāḥ | evamādiṣu na kaścit‌ adhikaraṇe pratyayo vihitaḥ | ityanuktatvādadhikaraṇe saptamī | ūkta saṃbaṃdha yathā | gomān‌ devadattaḥ | ayamarthaḥ | gāvo vidhyaṃte yasya sa gomān‌ | tadasyāstīti saṃbaṃdhe matupratyayaḥ | evaṃ citragurdevadattaḥ samāso'tra saṃbaṃdhe | ata evamādiṣūktatvātsaṃbaṃdhe prathamā | anuktaḥ saṃbaṃdho yathā | gāvo vidhyaṃte yasya devadattasya | athavā gobhirvidyate devadattasya | evaṃ rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ | vṛkṣasya śākhā | evamādiṣvanuktatvātsaṃbaṃdhe ṣaṣṭhī | uktānuktayordigmātramidam‌ | prapaṃcastu yathāsthānamuttaratra darśayiṣyāmaḥ | nanu ko nāma kārakaṣaṭkaṃ saṃbaṃdhaṃ ca vakti | yo yatra pratyayo jātaḥ samāso yatra vā bhavet | sa eva vakti yuñjānastasya liṃgena saṃkhyayā || 3 || yo yatretyādi | ayamarthaḥ | yaḥ pratyayastaddhitastyādiḥ kṛdvā yatrārthe kārake saṃbaṃdhe na jātaḥ | samāso yatrārthe bhavet‌ | sa pratyayaḥ | samāsaśca enamiti yatrārthaḥ vihitastamarthaṃ vakti | kiṃbhūto bhavan‌ vakti tatrāha | yuñjānaḥ saṃbaṃdhyamānastasyoktasya liṃgena strīpuṃnapuṃsakena saṃkhyayā ekavacanadvivacanabahuvacanairiti ayamabhiprāyaḥ | yo yamarthamabhidadhāti sa tasyaiva liṃgasaṃkhyābhyāṃ yukto bhavati | tadyathā | kārakaḥ puruṣaḥ | kārikā strī | kārakaṃ kulamiti | vaiyākaraṇaḥ puruṣaḥ | vaiyākaraṇī strī | vaiyākaraṇaṃ kulam‍ | kṛtapraṇāmaḥ puruṣaḥ | kṛtapraṇāmā strī | kṛtapraṇāmaṃ kulam‌ | kārike striyau | kārikāḥ striyaḥ | kārakau puruṣau | kārakāḥ puruṣāḥ | kārake kule | kārakāni kulāni | ityādi | evamanye'pi kṛttaddhitasamāseṣu liṃgasaṃkhyāniyamo jñātavyaḥ | ākhyātikapratyayastu na liṃgaṃ grahītumarhati | uktasya saṃkhyāmātramupādatte | tadyathā | udanaṃ pacati sūpakāraḥ | udanaṃ pacataḥ sūpakārau | udanaṃ pacati sūpakārāḥ | udanaṃ pacati strī | udanaṃ pacataḥ striyau | udanaṃ pacanti striyaḥ | udanaṃ pacati kulam‌ | udanaṃ pacataḥ kule | udanaṃ pacanti kulāni | evaṃ kaṭaḥ kriyate devadattena | kaṭau kriyete devadattena | kaṭāḥ kriyante devadattena | evaṃ sarvatra | tvaṃyuvāṃyūyamityebhiryoge punaryuṣmādimadhyama iti madhyamapuruṣo bhavati | yathā tvaṃ bhavasi | yuvāṃ bhavathaḥ | yūyaṃ bhavatha | evaṃ tvaṃ hanyase devadattena | yuvāṃ hanyethe devadattena | yūyaṃ hanyadhve devadattena | evama sarvatra ahamāvāṃvayamityebhiryoge tu narasmadyuttama ityuttamapuruṣo bhavati | tadyathā | ahaṃ bhavāmi | āvāṃ bhavāvaḥ | vayaṃ bhavāmaḥ | evaṃ ahaṃ hanye devadattena | āvāṃ hanyāvahe devadattena | vayaṃ hanyāmahe devadattena | evaṃ sarvatra | anyatra tu nāmni prayujyamāne'pi prathamaḥ puruṣo bhavati | tadyathā | devadatto bhavati | devadattau bhavataḥ | devadattā bhavanti | abhibhavati tvāṃ devadattaḥ | jānāti māṃ devadattaḥ | pacyate udanastvayā | kriyate kaṭo mayā | (mayā sthīyate | tvayā bhūyate |) evaṃ sarvatra liṃgasaṃkhyāniyamaḥ kathitaḥ | uktaṃ tu prathamakārikāyāmudāhṛtameva tacca digmātramidam | anyatrāpyākhyākṛttaddhitasamāsairevoktam yuktitaḥ pratipattavyam‌ | yadā bhāve pratyayaḥ | tadā na kiṃciduktaṃ bhavati | tatrākarmakebhyo dhātubhyo bhāvavihitapratyayo bhavati | sakarmakebhyo'pi bhavati | yadi karma na vivakṣyate | prayogaḥ | bhūyate devadattena | sthīyate yuvābhyām‌ | pacyate asmābhiḥ | gamyate devadattenetyādi | bhāvaḥ sattā | sattā cāsaṃkhyeti tasyāmabhidheyā yāmautsargikamekavacanaṃ prathamapuruṣasyaiva bhavati | bhāvavihitakṛtpratyayānāṃ tu prayoge karmakārakamapi vivakṣaṇīyam‌ | bhāve'pi dhātvarthakṛtā vyāptirastīti nyāyātprayogaḥ | yathā grāmaṃ gaṃtuṃ udyataḥ | udanaṃ bhuktvā vrajati | evamanyatrāpyūhanīyam‌ | nanu yasya pradhānakriyāsaṃbaṃdhāduktatvam‌ | anuktatvaṃ ca guṇakriyābhisaṃbaṃdhāttādṛśaṃ sakalamevoktaṃ bhavatītyapi vaktavyam‌ | tena udanaḥ paktvā bhujyate | uktārthatvādodane prathamaiva | anyathā anuktaddhāreṇa dvitīyā'pi syātsatyaṃ pradhānānuyāyino vyavahārāḥ | tata udnasya karmaṇaḥ pradhānaśaktiścet‌ bhujikriyānibaṃdhanābhihitā pacanakriyānibaṃdhanā'pi apradhānaśaktirabhihivat pratibhāsate tataḥ kuto anabhihate vihatānāṃ dvitīyādīnāmavakāśaḥ | taduktaṃ pradhānaśaktirabhidhāne guṇaśaktirabhihitavat‌ prakāśata iti | sādhyatvāt bhojanakriyāyāḥ prādhānyam | gauṇatvaṃ ca kṛdaṃtakriyāyāstadviśeṣanatvāditi evaṃ devadatto bhuktvā vrajati | ityādāvapi nyāyasya tulyatvādukte kartari prathamaiva bhavati na kadācidanuktaddhāreṇa tṛtīyā | evamanyatrāpi tasmāduktatvasya nyāyādeva siddhatvādiha viśeṣo na vaktavya iti | liṃgasaṃkhyābhiyogaśca prāyo bhavati darśitaḥ | vedāḥ pramāṇamityādi prayogo yena sammataḥ || 4 || liṃgasaṃkhyetyādi | subodham‌ | pramīyate yena tatpramāṇamiti | karaṇādhikaraṇayośceti adhikaraṇe yuṭ | mukhyaṃ kartāramācaṣṭe pratyayo'nekakartṛko | mukhyaḥ prayojako jñeyaḥ prayukto nāparairyadi || 5 || mukhyamityādi | ayamarthaḥ | ānakakartṛke dhātau kartari vihitaḥ pratyayo mukhyameva kartāramācaṣṭe mukhyaśca prayojako jñātavyaḥ prayatnavatvāt‌ | nau vedasau prayojako'paraiḥ prayukto bhavet‌ | prayukto hi anya eva prayatnavāniti tasyaiva prādhānyam‌ | tadyathā | yadā yajñadattena prayukto devadatta udanaḥ pacati | tadā pacati kaścit‌ tamanyaḥ prayuṅkte iti vākye dhātuśca hetāviti | pacadhātorin‌ kartari parasmaipādaṃ prayogaḥ pācayatyodanaṃ devadattena yajñadattaḥ | uktārthatvāt‌ yajñadatte kartari prathamā | devadatte kartari kartaryanuktatvāttṛtīyā | yadā tu devadattasya prayojako yajñadatto viṣṇumitreṇa prayukta san‌ pācayati | tadā anayā rītyā pāahyato inaṃtādapi punarinprayogaḥ | pācayatyodanaṃ devadattena yajñadattena viṣṇumitraḥ | atra pradhānatvādukte viṣṇumitre kartari prathamā | anukte tu sarvatra tṛtīyā | īdṛśī sārvatrikī nītiḥ | duhādergauṇakaṃ karma duhāderityādi | asyāyamarthaḥ duhādeḥ karmaṇi jātaḥ pratyayo gauṇameva karma vakti na pradhānam‌ | abhidhānāt‌ | duhādayo | duhiyācirudhipracchibhikṣiviñāmupayoganimittamapūrvavidhau bruviśāsiguṇena ca yatsa ca etadakīrtitamācaritaṃ kavinā iti | atra cakāreṇa jayatiprabhṛtīnāmapi grahaṇam‌ | jayatyarthayatemaṃthisturyo daṃḍayatītyapi ebhiḥ mahadbuddhairjñeyā dvādaśete duhādayaḥ | duhyate gauḥpayo gopālakena | yācyate pauravaḥ kaṃbalaṃ baṭunā | rudhyate gaurvrajaṃ gopālakena pṛcchyate chātraḥ paṃthānaṃ pathikena bhikṣyate pauravo gāṃ dvijena vakṣo'vacīyate phalāni lokaiḥ ucyate śiṣyo dharmamupādhyāyena | śiṣyo'nuśiṣyate śāstraṃ paṇḍitena | evaṃ grāmaḥ śataṃ jīyate chātreṇa | gargrāḥ śataṃ daṃḍyate nṛpeṇa | prārthyate gāṃ gṛhamedhī dvijena mathyate sma jaladhiramṛtaṃ devāsuraiḥ | atraupayujyamānaṃ payaḥprabhṛtikaṃ karmapradhānaṃ atastannimittaṃ gavādikaṃ gauṇam‌ | gauṇatvātkarmaṇi vihitenātmanepadenoktamityukte karmaṇi prathamā | anukte tu dvitiyā|| nīvahādeḥ pradhānakam | nīvahādeḥ pradhānakamiti | karmajaḥ pratyayaḥ karma vaktīti pratyekamabhisaṃbaṃdhaḥ | tatra nīvahādayo yathā nīdhotdyohryutkṛṣoścāpi gatyarthānāṃ tathaiva ca dvikarmakeṣu grahaṇaṃ ṇyaṃte kartuśca karmaṇaḥ prayogo yathā | nīyate bhāro grāmaṃ devadattena | utdyate bhāro grāmaṃ devadattena | hriyate kuṃbho grāmaṃ devadattena| ajā grāmamākṛṣyate janena | atra bhārādernīyamānasya pradhānatvāt‌ uktatvaṃ | inaṃte kartṛkarmaiva anyadvā vakti karmajaḥ || 6|| inaṃte kartṛkarmevānyadveti | ayamarthaḥ | inaṃte dhātau pūrvakartā san‌ yaḥ paścātkarma bhavati tatkarma karmajaḥ pratyato vakti | anyadvā grāmādikaṃ karma | ayamabhiprāyaḥ| śiṣṭaprayogānusāreṇa inaṃte paryāyeṇa karmoktaṃ bhavati | iti ṭīkākāraḥ| tadyathā grāmaṃ gamyate devadatto yajñadattena | grāmo devadattamiti vā | evamodanaṃ bhojyate devadatto yajñadattena | udano devadattamiti vā | bodhyate dharmaṃ śiṣyo'dhyāpakena | dharmaḥ śiṣyamiti vā | māṇavako'dhyāpyate vedamupādhyāyena māṇavakaṃ veda iti vā | māsamāsyate devadatto yajñadattena | māso devadattamiti vā | akarmakāṇāṃ prayoge kālāddhvabhāvādeśānāṃ karmasaṃjñā siddhaiveti māsasya karmatvam‌ | kālādibhiryoge'pyakarmakāṇāmanini sati yaḥ kartā sa ini vyāpya vivakṣayāṃ karmasaṃjño bhavati | nanu yadi paryāyo'tra sammataḥ | tatkathaminaṃte kartṛkarmaivetyevakāraḥ | satyaṃ gatyarthādeḥ kartṛkarmaiveti niyamasya keṣāṃcidabhimatatvātprāyaścainameva pakṣamāśritya prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ | aparastu pakṣaḥ saṃbhavātdarśita iti | gamanāhārabodhārthaśabdārthāḥ karmadhātuṣu | aninaṃteṣu yaḥ kartā syādinaṃteṣu karma tat || 7 || gamanāhāretyādi| sarvatra anini sati yaḥ kartā tasyeni sati vyāpyatvāt karmatāpatrau niyamaḥ | prayogaḥ | gatyarthānāṃ tāvatgrāmaṃ gacchati devadattaḥ | grāmaṃ gamayati devadattaṃ yajñadattaḥ | (yātuṃ necchati | tena yāpayati grāmaṃ devadattena yajñadattaḥ |) saṃpadaṃ prāpnoti caitraḥ | prāpayati saṃpadaṃ caitraṃ nṛpaḥ | āhārārthānāṃ yathā | udanaṃ bhuṃkte devadattaḥ | bhojayatyodanaṃ devadatamīśvaraḥ | payaḥ pibati cātakaḥ | pāyayati payaḥ cātakaṃ jaladaḥ | bodhanārthānāṃ yathā budhyate śiṣyo bodhayati dharmaṃ śiṣyamupādhyāyaḥ | paśyati caitraṃ mitraḥ | caitraṃ darśayati maitraṃ viṣṇumitraḥ | śabdārthānāṃ yathā | paṭhati
